source_inspection.scope: Sload 2020 pp105–111, selected text examined; PDF figures not visually verified

findings.assertion: TE28 Area C:West Layer 3a faunal remains included Neotoma sp. (MNI 1–2), Dipodomys sp. (MNI 1), and tentatively Neotomodon alstoni (MNI 1). Bones showed no burning, roasting, or other cultural modification. Griffiths interpreted them as likely intrusive rodents rather than deliberate offerings.
findings.locator: Sload 2020 ch.7 printed pp.109–110, Table 7.1, parsed PDF lines 3109–3114
findings.limitation: Original Griffiths faunal report not checked; screenshot of figures timed out.

findings.assertion: Cave TE28 Area C:West Layer 5f contained a burrow beneath Rock 2 tapering toward the former Blockage 12. Small find 40 comprised at least 81 animal-bone fragments later assessed from photographs rather than direct reexamination of specimens.
findings.locator: Sload 2020 ch.7 printed pp.110–111, parsed PDF lines 3188–3192, Fig.7.7 cited
findings.limitation: Figure not visually checked; burrow not directly dated.

findings.assertion: Cave TE28 Area C:West Layer 3a fire pit near Blockage 12 contained a semicircular burnt shell and fish-bone concentration 25 × 35 cm (small finds 23–25). Sload interprets the feature as possibly linked to closure, not securely to pyramid construction.
findings.locator: Sload 2020 ch.7 printed pp.105–107, PDF lines 3100–3103, 3145–3147, Altschul 1978a:128–129 cited
findings.limitation: Original Altschul record and figures not directly examined this run.
